title: material_palette
description: The `material_palette` content kind (megaplan 1.7, task 3-A1): which replica block a Cyberpunk surface becomes. `codes`: the material code (0 unknown, 1..10 concrete_light, concrete_dark, asphalt, sidewalk, glass, metal, brick, tile, ground, water, 11..26 neon in vanilla dye order) a `ground.m` entry carries -> block and representative colour (code 0 is the last resort when no heuristic applies). `match`: ordered; the first entry with a name that is a substring of the lower-cased probe material or mesh appearance name wins (the shared name table that maps names to codes is derived from this list). `heuristic`: used for a cell whose code is 0 (no material readable, Phase 0 b): `water` for the Atlas water flag, `street_height` and `tower_height` (metres above the local ground) split floors into street and raised floors and walls into ordinary and tower walls, then `default` plus the first `districts` entry whose key is a substring of the lower-cased `stats.district` (its set overrides the default key by key). Block ids are `cyberblock:nc_<material>` registered by the replica package; a missing block makes the loader skip the entry. Files merge by id order; a datapack may ship only the parts it changes.

heuristicSet.description: street: a floor at street level; raised: a floor above street_height (roofs, platforms, bridges); wall: a wall cell up to tower_height; tower: a wall cell above it.
